description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Developer Analyst - IT with strong hands-on expertise in the Microsoft .NET ecosystem. The role will design, develop, enhance, and support scalable enterprise applications, full-stack solutions, and APIs while working closely with product, architecture, business, quality assurance, and engineering teams.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong .NET development skills with Microsoft Azure experience and practical exposure to Generative AI solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise applications using C# and .NET/.NET Core.
* Build scalable full-stack applications, REST APIs, and microservices using Microsoft technologies.
* Translate business and functional requirements into secure, reliable, and maintainable technical solutions.
* Contribute to application architecture, technical design, API design, and database design discussions.
* Develop and optimize database solutions using SQL Server and Entity Framework or other ORM technologies.
* Apply Object-Oriented Programming principles, SOLID principles, and appropriate design patterns.
* Integrate applications with internal and external APIs and enterprise services.
* Improve application performance, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Troubleshoot complex application and production issues and perform root-cause analysis.
* Build and maintain automated deployment processes using Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Participate in code reviews, unit testing, technical documentation, release activities, and production support.
* Contribute to Generative AI use cases and AI-enabled capabilities within enterprise applications.
* Collaborate effectively with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, QA, DevOps, and development teams.
* Mentor junior developers and promote development standards and engineering best practices.

**Required Experience**

* 6-10 years of overall software development experience, preferably in full-stack application development.
* Strong hands-on experience across the .NET ecosystem.
* Approximately 1-2 years of hands-on experience or project exposure in Generative AI.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure technologies and cloud-based application delivery.
* Experience developing and supporting enterprise-grade applications.

Must-Have Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong expertise in C# and .NET Core 6+
* ASP.NET Core and Web API development.
* Experience developing REST APIs and microservices.
* Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
* Strong experience with SQL Server and database development.
* Strong understanding of Entity Framework or equivalent ORM technologies.
* Experience with secure application development, authentication and authorization, and API integration.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  

* HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Experience with a modern frontend framework such as Angular or React.
* Experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Service.
* Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Application performance tuning, scalability, and production troubleshooting.
* Automated testing and unit-testing frameworks.
* Application monitoring and observability tools such as Application Insights.
* Cloud-native development and containerization.

Generative AI Experience
  
  
Experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred:
  
  

* Integrating Generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Experience working with GitHub Copilot
* Large Language Models and prompt engineering.
* Azure OpenAI Service or a comparable enterprise AI platform.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, or vector search.
* AI API integration with .NET applications.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving.
* Ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Good understanding of enterprise application architecture.
* Clear communication and effective collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and provide technical guidance to other developers.
* Interest in continuously learning cloud-native and Generative AI technologies.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
A hands-on .NET Full Stack professional who can independently design and deliver backend and API solutions, work effectively with SQL Server and Microsoft Azure, understand modern frontend technologies, troubleshoot complex production issues, and contribute to the adoption of Generative AI within enterprise applications.
  
  
**About Medline India**
Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance & and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024.
  
  
We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.
  
  
**About Medline Industries, LP**
Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.
  
  
At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the #1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

title: Robotics Software Intern
description:
**Help a fleet work as one system**

A robot completing its task is useful. A fleet completing tasks together - without deadlocks, traffic jams, or lost work - is what we’re building.

PickCell Robotics is developing robotic systems for dark stores. We’re looking for an intern to help build the software that coordinates multiple mobile robots: planning routes, assigning and queuing tasks, sharing status, managing traffic, and recovering when things go wrong.

You’ll work across the fleet manager and robot software, then test your work in simulation and on real robots.

**What you’ll work on**

1. Path planning: implement and evaluate graph-based planning methods such as A\\* and Dijkstra’s algorithm; explore sampling-based methods such as RRT where appropriate.
2. Multi-robot coordination: coordinate routes and shared spaces, manage right-of-way, and reduce conflicts, congestion, and deadlocks.
3. Task management: build task assignment and scheduling logic, including task queues, priorities, robot availability, and task status tracking.
4. Fleet communication: design message flows for task dispatch, robot status, acknowledgements, and fault reporting.
5. Recovery behaviour: handle blocked routes, delayed or failed tasks, robot disconnections, and robots that stop unexpectedly.
6. System integration: connect the fleet manager to individual robot controllers and supporting software.
7. Testing and observability: create simulations, logs, and diagnostic tools to understand how the fleet behaves as the number of robots and tasks grows.

**Skills we’re looking for**

1. Programming experience in Python and/or C++.
2. Understanding of core data structures and algorithms, especially graphs, search, queues, and scheduling.
3. Familiarity with one or more path planning algorithms, such as A\\*, Dijkstra, RRT, or related graph-based methods.
4. Interest in multi-agent systems, robotics, or distributed software.
5. Comfort using Linux and Git.
6. Ability to break down a problem, test edge cases, and explain your technical decisions.

**Useful experience**

1. ROS or ROS 2, including nodes, topics, services, or actions.
2. Robot navigation, localisation, SLAM, occupancy grids, or costmaps.
3. Multi-agent pathfinding or traffic coordination.
4. Task schedulers, job queues, state machines, or event-driven systems.
5. Networking or messaging systems such as DDS, MQTT, or WebSockets.
6. Simulation tools such as Gazebo or Webots.

You don’t need to know every algorithm or tool listed. We’re interested in solid fundamentals and the ability to learn, implement, and test systems that have to work together.

**What you’ll build and learn**

You’ll help turn a group of individual robots into a coordinated fleet. That means working on practical questions such as how tasks should be assigned, how robots should share narrow aisles, and what the system should do when its plan stops working.

Your code will be tested in simulation and on real robots, with the opportunity to contribute to a core part of PickCell’s product.
